label: Prozorro (Ukrainian public procurement)
terms_note: Public read API of the Prozorro e-procurement system (documentation in Ukrainian and English on Read the Docs), no key. The tender feed pages by an opaque `offset` token returned in next_page.offset (a cursor, not a number). Docs vs live 2026-10-01: opt_fields=title,value is silently reduced to procuringEntity,status,tenderID,tenderPeriod (visible in the answer's own next_page.path), so feed rows carry no title or value - search_postings titles fall back to the tender number and get_posting has the full record. Records include the buyer's contact person; the catalog stores none of it. Unknown id: 404 {"status":"error","errors":[{"description":"Not Found"}]}.

search_postings.note: The most recently modified tenders first (any status; raw.status). There is no search: query, category and min_budget are not applied. Pages by cursor only.

get_posting.note: One tender by its 32-hex id (search_postings), in Ukrainian; budget_max is the expected value (value.amount, UAH).

not_offered.me: Bidding needs an accredited e-procurement platform (broker); the public API has no accounts.
not_offered.submit_bid: Bids are placed through accredited brokers, not the public API.
not_offered.list_messages: Questions and answers are inside each tender record; no message inbox.

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
